comparison.objective: Candidate commissions an industrial damper; record pauses a mechanical chess clock without activating the opposing clock.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires keyed release, collar tuning, stabilization, tightening, and impact testing; record requires selective button actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate evaluates physical stopping behavior and adjustment retention. Record specifies the desired clock state but has no body, specs, timing tolerance, or scoring details.
comparison.reason: Selective clock actuation does not test fine mechanical calibration, tool use, or dynamic energy absorption.
